name: Santa María de la Isla (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green with a blue triangle with its base along the hoist bearing a ring of white stars.
history: The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three horizontal stripes of equal proportions; it is rectangular for aesthetic reasons, so as to have the same shape as the flags of Spain and Castile and León, with which it must always fly.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
ring of stars on the triangle
